decision.reason: Both excerpts [ev-2875a348b5d7] and [ev-59d22c21eec4] show only '/*', so neither file excerpt displays the added line or the code around it. The change text is just one comment line that stops mid-sentence ("Crossplane returns an"). It does not say which features or flags were removed, how removal shows up, who is exposed or what happens to an operator who still uses them. We need the full comment block and the code that follows it in v2.0.0 core.go (for example, the list of removed flags or features and the error behaviour), or a matching release note or upgrade-guide section.
